title: Bal Ganesh aur exam ka darr
title_dev: बाल गणेश और एग्ज़ाम का डर
summary: Kalyug ke Bhagwan: Chintu ko exam ka darr, Bal Ganesh ne Vyas ji ki shart (har shlok samajh kar likhna) se sikhaya: ratna nahi, samajh kar padho
lesson: Samajh kar padho, ek-ek paath dhyan se; dar bhaagta hai, aur kaam ka 'Shri Ganesh' karo
source: Mahabharata (Adi Parva) ki prasiddh katha: Maharishi Vyas ne Mahabharata boli aur Shri Ganesh ne likhi; Vyas ji ki shart thi ki Ganesh ji har shlok samajh kar hi likhein. Kalam tootne par daant tod kar likhna lok-katha hai ('kehte hain').

facts.claim: Maharishi Vyas ne Mahabharata boli aur Shri Ganesh ne likhi (Adi Parva ki prasiddh katha; critical edition ise baad ka jod maanta hai)
Ganesh ji ki shart: Vyas ji bina ruke bolein; Vyas ji ki shart: Ganesh ji har shlok samajh kar hi likhein
Lok-katha: kalam tooti to Ganesh ji ne apna daant tod kar likhna jaari rakha (isliye 'kehte hain')

scenes.prompt: A cosy small Indian bedroom at night, a ten-year-old boy Chintu sits at a wooden study desk piled high with school books and notebooks, his head in his hands, looking worried, a warm desk lamp glowing, a window with a night sky behind him, medium shot
scenes.animate: the boy sighs and rubs his forehead, the warm lamp light flickers softly, a page of the open book lifts slightly

lines.tts: कल एग्ज़ाम है, और मुझे कुछ भी याद नहीं हो रहा!
lines.sub: Kal exam hai, aur mujhe kuch bhi yaad nahi ho raha!

lines.tts: गणपति बप्पा, अब आप ही कुछ कीजिए!
lines.sub: Ganpati Bappa, ab aap hi kuch kijiye!

scenes.prompt: The same cosy Indian bedroom at night, little Bal Ganesh sits cross-legged on top of a stack of school books on the study desk inside a soft golden glow, smiling and holding out a round modak sweet, a surprised happy ten-year-old boy Chintu sits at the desk looking at him, warm desk lamp, medium shot
scenes.animate: a soft golden glow shimmers around little Ganesha and tiny sparkles float in the air, his big ears flap gently, the boy's face lights up with surprise

lines.tts: डरो मत चिंटू, मैं आ गया!
lines.sub: Daro mat Chintu, main aa gaya!

lines.tts: गणेश जी? आप सच में आ गए?
lines.sub: Ganesh ji? Aap sach mein aa gaye?

lines.tts: हाँ! पहले ये मोदक खाओ, फिर एक कहानी सुनो।
lines.sub: Haan! Pehle ye modak khao, phir ek kahani suno.

scenes.prompt: A peaceful forest ashram beside a river in ancient India, little Bal Ganesh sits on a low wooden seat inscribing long palm-leaf manuscripts with a stylus, beside him the elderly sage Maharishi Vyasa with a long white beard and saffron robes speaks with one hand raised, warm sunlight through the trees, gentle storybook flashback

lines.tts: महर्षि व्यास जी महाभारत बोलते गए, और मैं लिखता गया।
lines.sub: Maharishi Vyas ji Mahabharat bolte gaye, aur main likhta gaya.

lines.tts: उनकी शर्त थी, हर श्लोक समझकर ही लिखना। रटना नहीं!
lines.sub: Unki shart thi, har shlok samajhkar hi likhna. Ratna nahi!

lines.tts: और कहते हैं, कलम टूटी तो मैंने अपना दाँत तोड़कर लिखना जारी रखा!
lines.sub: Aur kehte hain, kalam tooti to maine apna daant todkar likhna jaari rakha!

scenes.prompt: The cosy Indian bedroom in soft morning light, a happy ten-year-old boy Chintu studies calmly at his tidy desk with an open book, little Bal Ganesh sits on the desk beside him happily eating a round modak, sunlight through the window, medium shot

lines.tts: तो मुझे भी समझकर पढ़ना है?
lines.sub: To mujhe bhi samajhkar padhna hai?

lines.tts: हाँ! एक-एक पाठ ध्यान से, बीच में छोटा ब्रेक, और अच्छी नींद।
lines.sub: Haan! Ek-ek paath dhyan se, beech mein chhota break, aur achhi neend.

lines.tts: थैंक यू गणेश जी! अब मैं नहीं डरूँगा।
lines.sub: Thank you Ganesh ji! Ab main nahi darunga.

endcard.tts: पढ़ाई का श्री गणेश करो! ऐसी और कहानियों के लिए सब्सक्राइब करो।
endcard.sub: Padhai ka Shri Ganesh karo! Aisi aur kahaniyon ke liye Subscribe karo.
